date_code.label: Date/Batch Code (tube cap emboss)
date_code.description: DDMMYY (6 digit MFG date) + 3-letter batch code + 1-digit Cosmax manufacture code, e.g. 310826ALZ8
date_code.roi_hint: Embossed on the tube cap/shoulder. Structure per reference doc: chars 1-6 = DDMMYY filling date, chars 7-9 = batch code letters (from PPIC batch number table), char 10 = single-digit Cosmax manufacture code. The knurl/ridge line next to the text has been misread as an extra character before (e.g. OCR read '13108260HB8' - 11 chars - instead of the correct '3108260HB8' - 10 chars - with high confidence; the '0' in that older sample was likely an OCR misread of the letter 'O'). If FORMAT_MISMATCH keeps showing one extra leading/trailing character on this field, narrow the Fixed ROI to exclude the ridge area when you define it.
